# Privatinvestor Jens Løgstrup rammer 30 pct.: Solgte DSV og Novo i tide

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-10-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Børsen Investor podcast with private investor Jens Løgstrup, who is up about 30% this year after 43% last year, and Johnny Madsen of Formue og Investeringspleje. The episode covers DSV's Q3 report: Johnny is bullish on synergies and buybacks, while Jens stays out because of doubts about management. Jens explains why he sold Novo Nordisk and is sticking with Torm, Jyske Bank, ISS, NKT, Sydbank and Chemometec. The hosts are wary of speculative AI and SpaceX hype and like Danish equities in general.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Johnny holds it and sees potential back to about 1,900: Road normalised, DKK 9bn synergies kept, buyback restarted. Guest Jens is out but may consider it in 2027.

#### Reasoning

Johnny (Formue og Investeringspleje) thinks DSV will deliver its DKK 9bn synergies and that buybacks could grow sharply in 2027 on strong cash flow. Road normalised by end-Q3. ROIC is depressed by merger costs and should recover. Jens (guest) is cautious on the CEO change and weak EPS, but would look at buying if the integration and synergies succeed. Simon (host) wants ROIC to recover first.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the DKK 9bn synergies are not delivered
- if Road Division keeps losing customers
- if ROIC does not recover after integration
- if management under Jens Lund falls short

> *"Det rykker altså ikke på min langsigtede case på den aktie."*

---

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Jens sold and has no plans to buy unless the price falls well below 250. Risks: copyable obesity drugs, acquisitions, patent cliff. Johnny still holds about 4%.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) sees too much risk: competitors are entering obesity, the CEO talks about acquisitions, and about 75% of revenue goes off patent around 2032-33 with no proven replacement. Johnny (guest) is less sceptical: acquisitions are now moderated and CagriSema data showed 25% weight loss. He agrees the range of outcomes is wider and that growth must return, or the P/E could fall to 8.

#### Sell Triggers

- price well below 250 would prompt a re-evaluation
- new patents or pipeline that clearly replace revenue
- growth returning

> *"Så jeg har den ikke, og jeg har absolut ikke planer om at købe den. Den skal langt under 250 kurs, før jeg vil vurdere på den igen."*

---

### 🟡 TRMD-A — Torm | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Jens holds a heavy position, up over 100% YTD. Product tanker fleet too small, demand rising, Hormuz tensions, large dividends expected to grow.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) says the global product tanker fleet is too small while demand for diesel, petrol and naphtha keeps rising, so rates stay high. Iran/Hormuz pushes rates further. Last quarter paid DKK 15/share and he expects a bigger next dividend. The stock is volatile: down 11% in a week, possibly on US-Russia diesel news.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tanker rates fall as fleet capacity grows
- if Hormuz tensions ease and rates normalise
- if dividends are cut

> *"Så det er jo altså voldsomme udbytte, man får udløjet nu her, og der er ikke nogen udsigt til, at det ændrer sig."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Book pick still held. Jens expects the next quarters to beat last year and buybacks to continue.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) expects Q4 2026 through Q2 2027 to be clearly better than a year earlier, supporting share gains and continued buybacks. He sees the banks as solid.

#### Sell Triggers

- if bank earnings weaken
- if buybacks stop

> *"Så jeg kan ikke se andet, end at bankerne vil ligge lugnt."*

---

### 🟡 SYDB — Sydbank (AL Sydbank) | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Jens expects bank earnings to rise and buybacks to grow once the merger is further along.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) gives the same view as for Jyske Bank: better earnings ahead and larger buybacks once the AL Sydbank merger is further along. The listener bought it on his advice.

#### Sell Triggers

- if merger integration falters
- if bank earnings fall

> *"Det samme vil ske i AL Sydbank, hvor man vil øge, tror jeg, når man er kommet lidt længere frem i fusionen."*

---

### 🟡 NKT — NKT | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Jens calls it a super stock: Karlskrona factory finishing, massive order book, structural power demand. Low 20% payout is the drawback.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) expects strong development as the Karlskrona plant is completed and the large order backlog converts, helped by rising electricity demand. The disappointment is the planned dividend of only 20% of earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the order book weakens
- if Karlskrona is delayed

> *"Men en super aktie."*

---

### 🟡 ISS — ISS | **HOLD** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Jens says the CEO is exceptionally capable, growth is picking up and the company buys back shares heavily.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) calls it an excellent position: slowly rising growth instead of decline, a strong CEO and large buybacks. Book pick, kept intact.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth turns negative
- if the CEO leaves

> *"Og man køber jo aktier hjem med arme og ben, så det er en forrygende position, de ligger i."*

---

### 🟡 CHEMM — Chemometec | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Jens has held it since about 20. High-margin consumables model; new larger instruments should lift earnings. Rich valuation makes it sensitive.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) likes the razor-and-blade model, with recurring high-margin kits sold to labs that are not price sensitive. New advanced cell-counting machines should lift earnings in the coming years. The risk is a high valuation, which makes the stock sensitive to any setback. It is down this year but has risen 60-70% since spring.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new instruments fail to gain traction
- if growth disappoints given the high valuation

> *"jeg synes stadigvæk, at den er vældig spændende"*

---

### 🟠 DFDS — DFDS | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Jens sold at a loss. Glad Polaris and new leadership are in; will follow closely but finds it expensive with no earnings lift.

#### Reasoning

Jens (guest) says previous management loaded the company with debt and losses. Polaris and the new CEO and chair could turn it around, but the price has risen without earnings improving, so he is not buying now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the restructuring fails to lift earnings
- if debt keeps rising

> *"Jeg har den ikke, og jeg synes, den er blevet meget dyr lige nu, i forhold til, at der jo ikke har været noget løft i indtjeningen."*

---
